description.text: Cyberspace Security is an interdisciplinary field that studies the confidentiality, integrity, availability, and resistance to attacks of information in the cyber space. From the private data in individuals' mobile phones to the stable operation of national critical infrastructures (such as power systems and financial networks), from the protection of corporate trade secrets to the prevention of cyber fraud, cyberspace security is the "immune system" of the digital age, directly safeguarding the digital security of individuals, organizations, and even countries.

duration.text: The Cyberspace Security at Xidian University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

requirements.text: 1: Applicants must not have aChinese nationality.2:Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy (free from infectious diseases and any physical or mental diseasethat would have impact on the normal study), and must abide by Chinese laws and regulations, as well as XidianUniversity's school rules and regulations, and respect China's social morals and customs.3:Applicants must be at least 18 years old.4:Language competency 1) lELTS score of 6.5 or above 2)TOEFLscore of 80 or above 3)Duolingo score of105 or above 4)Applicants with a previous degree taughtin English may be exempted from providingEnglish language test scores if theyprovide relevant proof.
